verdict: Micron's revenue rose 57% in a year to a record $13.6B as AI demand lifted every memory business — gross margin widened to 56% and net income nearly tripled to $5.2B.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago — the AI memory supercycle

segments.name: Cloud Memory
segments.note: High-bandwidth memory (HBM) stacked right beside AI processors in cloud servers — the scarcest, most valuable memory Micron makes, at a 66% gross margin this quarter.

segments.name: Core Data Center
segments.note: DRAM and NAND for conventional cloud and enterprise data-center servers — nearly flat in a year while AI memory boomed.

segments.name: Mobile and Client
segments.note: Memory for smartphones, PCs and other consumer devices — a 54% gross margin this quarter.

segments.name: Automotive and Embedded
segments.note: Memory for cars, factories and industrial equipment — smaller and steadier than the AI-driven units.

segments.name: All other
segments.note: Small leftovers outside the four business units.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next generations of DRAM, HBM and NAND memory.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Sales teams and the cost of running the company.

follow100Note: Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: A record quarter
takeaways.text: Revenue rose from $8.7B a year ago to a record $13.6B — and Micron guided the next quarter to $18.7B, another huge step up.

takeaways.title: Margins widened fast
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 56%, up from 38% a year ago and 45% last quarter — with memory supply this tight, price increases fall almost straight through to profit.

takeaways.title: Profit nearly tripled
takeaways.text: Net income of $5.2B, up from $1.9B a year ago. Cloud Memory — the AI unit — doubled its revenue to $5.3B at a 66% gross margin. Non-GAAP net income was $5.5B.

otherDetail: Interest income of $139M on Micron's growing cash pile, less $74M of interest expense and $140M of other non-operating expense, plus an $8M gain from equity-method investments — a net -$67M.
footerNote: Business-unit revenues are as reported by Micron; 'All other' is the small residual outside the four units.
